title: Three materials
desc: A spring shelf drops three balls of the same size from the same height; only their materials differ.

title: Strike
desc: A ball that is not in the photo rolls in and hooks into the pocket; ten pins scatter in slow motion.
credit: Let’s Go Bowling (2), Musicman Loxton, CC BY 2.0, cropped.

title: Gravity off
desc: The cargo bay loses its gravity: three objects lift off, drift and tumble, and bump into each other in mid-air.

title: Chain reaction
desc: One slab tips and the whole row of giant dominoes goes down, each pushing the next, shown in slow motion.

title: Barrels
desc: The top barrel rolls off the pile and swings the hanging sign aside; then the upright barrel tips over and rocks to a stop.
credit: Stacked barrels, Settlers Country Manor, Bjankuloski06, CC BY 4.0, cropped.

title: A sixth of g
desc: On the Moon a light push sends a crate and a canister on long, slow arcs; they land softly and settle.

title: Off the stack
desc: Two wheels slide off a stack of winter tyres; each lands on its rim edge, wobbles and settles flat.
credit: Car tire stack, Santeri Viinamäki, CC BY-SA 4.0, cropped.
